Genre.Fantasy: Fantasy fiction with magic, wizards, dragons, mythical creatures, imaginary worlds and epic quests
Genre.Science Fiction: Science fiction about space travel, aliens, robots, advanced technology, time travel and possible futures

Genre.Thriller & Suspense: Gripping thriller and suspense novel with danger, conspiracies, spies, chases and high-stakes tension
Genre.Horror: Horror fiction with ghosts, monsters, haunted places, the supernatural and creeping fear
Genre.Romance: Romance novel about love, passion, relationships and falling in love, with an emotional love story
Genre.Historical Fiction: Historical fiction, a novel set in a real period of the past where characters live through historical events
Genre.Literary Fiction: Literary fiction, a character-focused novel with artistic prose, psychological depth and insight into society

Genre.Humour: Funny, comic and satirical book full of jokes, wit and amusing situations
Genre.Biography & Memoir: Biography, autobiography and memoir telling the true life story of a real person
Genre.History: Non-fiction history book about past events, wars, empires, civilizations and historical figures
Genre.Science & Nature: Popular science and nature writing about physics, biology, the universe, animals and the environment
Genre.Self-help & Psychology: Self-help and psychology book about habits, motivation, relationships, mental health and personal development
Genre.Philosophy & Religion: Philosophy, religion and spirituality exploring the meaning of life, ethics, belief, God and the human condition
Genre.Poetry & Drama: Poetry collections and theatre plays, verse, lyrical writing and dramatic works for the stage
Genre.Graphic Novels & Comics: Graphic novels, comics and manga that tell a story through illustrated panels
Genre.Business & Economics: Business, economics and finance book about management, markets, entrepreneurship, investing and leadership
